apps.description:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>秦若岚 · 女王的坠落</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  :root {
    --gold: #d4af37;
    --gold-light: #f4d76e;
    --purple: #6a0dad;
    --purple-dark: #2a0845;
    --purple-deep: #1a0529;
    --bg: #0a0014;
    --card: rgba(30, 10, 50, 0.68);
    --border: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.35);
    --text: #f0e8d8;
    --text-dim: #b8a8c8;
    --red: #ff4757;
    --green: #2ed573;
    --header-h: 64px;
  }
  html, body { height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }
  body {
    font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at top, var(--purple-dark) 0%, var(--bg) 60%);
    color: var(--text);
    min-height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    line-height: 1.6;
    padding-top: var(--header-h);
  }
  #particles { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  .container { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 16px 60px; }

  /* ============ 悬浮纯文字弹幕 (无底色、纯文字、穿透点击、不遮挡) ============ */
  #danmaku-container {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    overflow: hidden;
    z-index: 800; /* 高于背景，低于顶部状态条与弹窗 */
  }
  .danmaku-item {
    position: absolute;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-size: clamp(0.92rem, 2vw, 1.12rem);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    opacity: 0.88;
    text-shadow: 1px 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9), 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    animation: danmakuFly linear forwards;
    will-change: transform;
    user-select: none;
  }

  @keyframes danmakuFly {
    0% { transform: translateX(100vw); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
  }

  /* ============ 顶部常驻悬浮债务进度条 ============ */
  .top-debt-bar {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: var(--header-h);
    background: rgba(16, 3, 26, 0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.4);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 15px rgba(106,13,173,0.3);
    z-index: 990;
    display: flex; align-items: center;
    padding: 0 18px;
  }
  .debt-bar-inner {
    max-width: 1200px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px;
  }
  .debt-stat { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .debt-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; animation: floaty 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .debt-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .debt-title-tag { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--gold-light); letter-spacing: 1px; opacity: 0.85; }
  .debt-number {
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 900;
    color: #ff6b81;
    text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.4);
  }
  .debt-number.bump { animation: bump 0.4s; }
  @keyframes bump { 30% { transform: scale(1.15); color: var(--gold-light); } }

  .debt-progress-container {
    flex: 1; max-width: 520px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;
  }
  .debt-progress-header {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-dim);
  }
  .debt-track {
    width: 100%; height: 9px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .debt-fill {
    height: 100%; width: 0%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff4757 0%, #e67e22 40%, #2ed573 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(46, 213, 115, 0.5);
    transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  }
  .top-status-badge {
    font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600;
    padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 12px;
    background: rgba(212,175,55,0.15);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--gold-light);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* ============ HERO ============ */
  .hero { text-align: center; padding: 20px 15px 15px; position: relative; }
  .hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5.5vw, 3rem);
    font-weight: 900;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold-light) 0%, var(--gold) 50%, #b8860b 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent;
    letter-spacing: 4px;
    animation: titleGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes titleGlow {
    0%,100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(212,175,55,0.4)); }
    50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 25px rgba(212,175,55,0.8)); }
  }
  .hero-sub { color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 6px; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 2px; }
  .portrait {
    width: 110px; height: 110px;
    margin: 15px auto 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a0dad, #d4af37);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(106, 13, 173, 0.6), 0 0 70px rgba(212,175,55,0.3);
    position: relative;
    animation: floaty 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .portrait img, .mini-avatar img {
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
  }
  @keyframes floaty { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-5px); } }
  .portrait::before {
    content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -4px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--gold), transparent, var(--gold));
    z-index: -1; animation: rotate 4s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes rotate { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

  /* ============ 女主设定展示专区 ============ */
  .heroine-lore-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(35, 10, 55, 0.8), rgba(20, 5, 35, 0.9));
    border: 1.5px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 24px;
    margin: 20px auto 25px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .heroine-lore-card::before {
    content: 'HEROINE PROFILE';
    position: absolute; right: 15px; top: 10px;
    font-size: 2.8rem; font-weight: 900;
    color: rgba(212,175,55,0.04);
    letter-spacing: 4px; pointer-events: none;
  }
  .lore-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border); padding-bottom: 12px; }
  .lore-header h3 { color: var(--gold-light); font-size: 1.25rem; }
  .lore-badge { background: rgba(212,175,55,0.2); color: var(--gold-light); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.75rem; }
  .lore-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
  .lore-item { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35); border-left: 3px solid var(--gold); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; }
  .lore-item-title { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--gold-light); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .lore-item-content { font-size: 0.88rem; color: #ddd; line-height: 1.6; }

  /* ============ FAVORABILITY ============ */
  .favor-panel {
    background: var(--card);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 20px;
    margin: 0 auto 25px;
  }
  .favor-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 600; }
  .favor-value { color: var(--gold-light); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 800; }
  .favor-bar {
    height: 12px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
    position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .favor-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #8e44ad 0%, #e74c3c 30%, #f39c12 60%, #2ecc71 100%);
    width: 10%;
    transition: width 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
  }
  .favor-stages { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .favor-desc {
    margin-top: 12px; padding: 10px 14px;
    background: rgba(106,13,173,0.25);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 0.88rem; min-height: 40px;
  }
  .favor-slider { width: 100%; margin-top: 12px; accent-color: var(--gold); }

  /* ============ 互动交易面板 ============ */
  .interact-card {
    background: var(--card);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 22px;
    margin-bottom: 25px;
  }
  .bubble {
    position: relative;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    min-height: 65px;
    font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.7;
  }
  .bubble::after {
    content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -8px; left: 35px;
    border-left: 8px solid transparent; border-right: 8px solid transparent;
    border-top: 8px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.6);
  }
  .cousin-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .mini-avatar {
    width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a0dad, #d4af37);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(106,13,173,0.5);
  }
  .mood-badge {
    background: rgba(212,175,55,0.12);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 0.8rem; margin-top: 2px; display: inline-block;
  }
  .action-group-title {
    color: var(--gold-light); font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.88rem; margin: 14px 0 8px; letter-spacing: 1px;
  }
  .action-buttons { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
  .action-btn {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 10px 6px;
    cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;
    text-align: center; color: var(--text);
    font-family: inherit;
  }
  .action-btn:hover { border-color: var(--gold); transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(212,175,55,0.25); }
  .action-btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
  .action-btn .a-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; display: block; }
  .action-btn .a-name { font-size: 0.82rem; margin-top: 4px; }
  .action-btn .a-amount { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--gold-light); margin-top: 2px; }
  .action-btn .a-favor { font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .action-btn.free { border-color: rgba(255,71,87,0.4); }
  .action-btn.free:hover { border-color: var(--red); }
  .reset-btn {
    margin-top: 15px; width: 100%;
    background: transparent; border: 1px dashed var(--border);
    color: var(--text-dim); padding: 9px 15px;
    border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 0.85rem; font-family: inherit; transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .reset-btn:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold-light); }

  /* ============ CARDS ============ */
  .cards-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; margin: 25px 0; }
  .info-card {
    background: var(--card);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 20px; cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .info-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: var(--gold);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(106,13,173,0.4);
  }
  .card-icon { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 6px; display: block; }
  .card-title { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold-light); margin-bottom: 5px; }
  .card-hint { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 0.82rem; }
  .card-badge {
    position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px;
    background: var(--gold); color: #1a0529;
    font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 15px;
  }

  /* ============ FORM ============ */
  .section-title {
    font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--gold-light);
    margin: 30px 0 15px; text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }
  .section-title::before, .section-title::after { content: '◆'; color: var(--gold); margin: 0 8px; font-size: 0.8rem; }
  .form-card {
    background: var(--card);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px;
  }
  .form-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
  .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .field.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .field label { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--gold-light); margin-bottom: 5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
  .field input[type="text"], .field input[type="number"], .field textarea {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 9px 12px;
    color: var(--text); font-size: 0.9rem; font-family: inherit;
    transition: all 0.2s; outline: none;
  }
  .field textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 70px; }
  .field input:focus, .field textarea:focus { border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(212,175,55,0.2); }
  .radio-group { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .radio-btn {
    flex: 1; min-width: 75px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    text-align: center; cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 0.85rem; user-select: none;
  }
  .radio-btn:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--text); }
  .radio-btn.active {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--gold));
    color: #fff; border-color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700;
  }
  .radio-btn input { display: none; }

  /* ============ TOGGLES ============ */
  .toggles-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
  .toggle-row {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15);
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .toggle-row:hover { border-color: var(--gold); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); }
  .toggle-name { font-size: 0.88rem; }
  .toggle-desc { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 2px; }
  .switch {
    position: relative; width: 40px; height: 22px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  .switch::after {
    content: ''; position: absolute;
    width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: #888; top: 2px; left: 2px; transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  .toggle-row.on .switch { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--gold)); border-color: var(--gold); }
  .toggle-row.on .switch::after { transform: translateX(18px); background: #fff; }

  /* ============ PREVIEW ============ */
  .preview-panel {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(26,5,41,0.92), rgba(42,8,69,0.92));
    border: 2px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 20px;
    position: sticky; top: calc(var(--header-h) + 15px);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(106,13,173,0.4);
  }
  .preview-title { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .preview-title h3 { color: var(--gold-light); font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .copy-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), #b8860b);
    color: #1a0529; border: none;
    padding: 7px 15px; border-radius: 8px;
    font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.82rem;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .copy-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.04); }
  .copy-btn.copied { background: var(--green); color: #fff; }
  .preview-content {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
    border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 0.84rem;
    max-height: 540px; overflow-y: auto;
    white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word;
    line-height: 1.65; color: #d8c8e8;
  }
  .preview-content .k { color: var(--gold-light); }
  .preview-content .v { color: #a8e6cf; }
  .preview-content .on { color: var(--green); }
  .preview-content .off { color: var(--red); }

  .main-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 25px; }
  @media (min-width: 980px) { .main-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px; } }

  /* ============ MODAL ============ */
  .modal-backdrop {
    position: fixed; inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    z-index: 1500;
    display: none;
    align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    padding: 20px;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
  }
  .modal-backdrop.active { display: flex; }
  .modal {
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1b052c, #2b0946);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 25px 20px;
    max-width: 650px; width: 100%;
    max-height: 80vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    position: relative;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
  }
  .modal::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
  .modal::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--gold); border-radius: 3px; }
  .modal::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }

  .modal-close {
    position: sticky; top: 0; float: right;
    width: 32px; height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); color: var(--gold);
    font-size: 1.1rem; cursor: pointer; z-index: 10;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .modal-close:hover { background: var(--gold); color: #000; }
  .func-item {
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35); border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
    padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 0.88rem;
  }
  .func-item h4 { color: var(--gold-light); margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 0.95rem; }
  .cmd {
    display: inline-block; background: rgba(212,175,55,0.18); color: var(--gold-light);
    padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  /* ============ TOAST ============ */
  .toast {
    position: fixed; top: 80px; left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-25px);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), #b8860b);
    color: #1a0529; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 30px;
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem;
    z-index: 2000;
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s;
  }
  .toast.show {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  }

  .sound-toggle {
    position: fixed; bottom: 20px; right: 20px;
    width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--gold); color: var(--gold);
    font-size: 1.1rem; cursor: pointer; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .confetti { position: fixed; top: -20px; width: 10px; height: 16px; z-index: 1100; pointer-events: none; animation: confettiFall 3.2s linear forwards; }
  @keyframes confettiFall { to { transform: translateY(105vh) rotate(720deg); opacity: 0.7; } }

  footer { text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 0.8rem; margin-top: 40px; padding: 10px; }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    :root { --header-h: 58px; }
    .top-status-badge { display: none; }
    .debt-number { font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .preview-panel { position: static; }
    .danmaku-item { font-size: 0.85rem; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============ 悬浮弹幕图层 (纯文字，无底色，穿透点击) ============ -->
<div id="danmaku-container"></div>

function ensureCtx() {
  if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();

}
function playTone(freq, dur=0.1, type='sine', vol=0.15) {
  if (!soundOn) return;

  osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);

}

function fallbackCopyTextToClipboard(text) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const textArea = document.createElement("textarea");
    textArea.value = text;
    // 隐藏在视图外
    textArea.style.position = "fixed";
    textArea.style.top = "-9999px";
    textArea.style.left = "-9999px";
    textArea.style.opacity = "0";
    document.body.appendChild(textArea);
    textArea.focus();
    textArea.select();
    
    try {
      const successful = document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(textArea);
      if (successful) {
        resolve();
      } else {
        reject(new Error('execCommand 复制失败'));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      document.body.removeChild(textArea);
      reject(err);
    }
  });
}

function doCopy(text) {
  if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
    return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
  } else {
    return fallbackCopyTextToClipboard(text);
  }
}

/* 终极兼容复制方案（完美支持 iOS Safari、安卓、各类 Webview） */
function copyText(text) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!text) {
      reject(new Error('复制内容为空'));
      return;
    }

    // 优先尝试现代 Clipboard API（仅在 HTTPS/非受限沙盒有效）
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
        .then(resolve)
        .catch(() => {
          // 如果现代 API 被沙盒权限拦截，自动无缝切换到备用 DOM 方案
          fallbackCopy(text).then(resolve).catch(reject);
        });
    } else {
      fallbackCopy(text).then(resolve).catch(reject);
    }
  });
}

function fallbackCopy(text) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const textArea = document.createElement("textarea");
    textArea.value = text;
    
    // 针对 iOS / 移动端优化的样式（防止页面缩放，保持在可视区内但透明）
    textArea.style.fontSize = '12pt';
    textArea.style.border = '0';
    textArea.style.padding = '0';
    textArea.style.margin = '0';
    textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
    textArea.style.left = '0';
    textArea.style.top = '0';
    textArea.style.opacity = '0.01';
    textArea.style.zIndex = '-9999';
    textArea.setAttribute('readonly', ''); // 防止移动端拉起软键盘

    document.body.appendChild(textArea);

    // 兼容 iOS 的选中方式
    textArea.focus();
    textArea.select();
    textArea.setSelectionRange(0, textArea.value.length);

    try {
      const successful = document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(textArea);
      if (successful) {
        resolve();
      } else {
        reject(new Error('浏览器禁用了复制命令'));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      document.body.removeChild(textArea);
      reject(err);
    }
  });
}
